description: This file defines the MessageFormatter class which formats HTTP messages (requests and responses) into log strings using templates with variable substitutions. It supports formatting various parts of HTTP messages, timestamps, and headers.

classes.name: MessageFormatter
classes.description: A class that formats HTTP request and response messages into log strings based on a specified template, replacing placeholders with message data, headers, timestamps, and error information.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MessageFormatter with an optional template string, defaulting to the Common Log Format.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Generates a formatted log message string for the given request, optional response, and optional error, replacing placeholders in the template with actual message and context data.
